class.name: NNHTNParallelTask
class.brief_description: Runs multiple independent primitive HTN tasks concurrently and commits their effects together.
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNHTNMethod] with primitive [NNHTNTask] (or [NNHTNSubtaskCall] to a primitive task) children when an agent should perform multiple non-conflicting actions at once (for example, moving to cover while reloading). During planning, the planner checks each branch's concurrency declarations ([member NNHTNTask.concurrency_contract_complete], [member NNHTNTask.actor_resources], read/write keys, and effects) to ensure branches do not conflict. If any branch is unsafe or conflicts, [member unsafe_policy] chooses whether to reject the group or fall back to running its branches sequentially. At runtime, all branches tick together until every branch succeeds, at which point their effects and [member effects] commit atomically. If any branch fails, unfinished siblings are cancelled and nothing is committed.

members.member: Group-level blackboard effects applied after all branches succeed. Must not write keys already written by a branch.
How planning handles a conflict or unavailable branch: [constant REJECT] backtracks to another alternative, while [constant SERIALIZE] falls back to planning the branches sequentially.

constants.constant: Rejects the group on conflict so the planner backtracks.
Falls back to planning the branches sequentially in scene order with a warning.
